OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_DECK_OF_WONDE: At the start of combat, shuffle 5 [gold]Scrolls of Wonder[/gold] into your draw pile.
“挑一张卡吧，哪张都行。等等！不！别动那张！”——之前一个主人的遗言
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_KURAS_DICE.de: At the start of each combat, rolls a random number from 1 to 6. Right-click this relic to activate the ability of the current roll. Each face can only be used once; after using the six, this relic is permanently disabled.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_KURAS_DICE.fl: 恢复，复制，强化，结界，爆炸，实现愿望。发动吧，命运之骰！
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_KURAS_DICE.de: The wish has been granted. Permanently disabled.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_KURAS_DICE.fa: All cards gain +1 [gold]Replay[/gold] for the rest of combat. {Status}
Damage dealt and Block gained are tripled this turn, and gain [blue]3[/blue] Energy. {Status}
Gain [green]8[/green] [gold]Buffer[/gold], [green]8[/green] [gold]Intangible[/gold], and [green]8[/green] [gold]Artifact[/gold] for the rest of combat. {Status}
Deal [blue]300[/blue] damage per player, split evenly among all enemies. {Status}
Gain [blue]999[/blue] Gold, heal to full, upgrade every card, gain [blue]6[/blue] relics, and permanently disable this relic. {Status}
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_ASHEN_FLASK.d: Removes one potion slot. Right-click this relic to restore [blue]15%[/blue] of your Max HP. Has 2 uses; kindling at a campfire refills it and raises the cap. Defeating an Elite or a Boss has a chance to restore one use.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_ASHEN_FLASK.c: Right-click this relic to restore [blue]15%[/blue] of your Max HP.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_ASHEN_FLASK.f: 自古以来，不死人总是在营火间穿梭，而原素瓶也一直随之旅行。
At the start of combat, gain [green]1[/green] [gold]Buffer[/gold] and [green]1[/green] [gold]Artifact[/gold]. At the start of each turn, heal [green]1[/green] HP; if you are below half your Max HP, heal [green]2[/green] instead.
来自泰拉瑞亚的配饰，在塔里它带给你自然恢复的力量。
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_SPORE_SAC.des: Whenever you take attack damage, apply Poison to the attacker, starting at [green]1[/green]. Every two combat wins adds [green]1[/green] more; within the same combat, from the second turn onward the Poison applied increases by [green]1[/green] each turn.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_SPORE_SAC.fla: 来自泰拉瑞亚的配饰，被激怒时会喷出剧毒的孢子云。
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_CROSS_NECKLAC: When you draw a Status or Curse card, Exhaust it and draw [blue]1[/blue] card. At the end of your turn, Exhaust the Status and Curse cards in your hand and gain [green]2[/green] Block.
来自泰拉瑞亚的配饰，据说能让佩戴者在受创的瞬间获得片刻庇护。
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_SHRINK_RAY.de: Right-click to gain a [gold]Shrink Ray[/gold] card. Unlimited.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_SHRINK_RAY.fl: 哆啦A梦的道具之一。被它的光照到的东西，都会变小。
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_AIR_CANNON.de: At the start of combat, add a 1-cost [gold]Bonk[/gold] card to your hand.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_AIR_CANNON.fl: 哆啦A梦的道具之一。套在手上，喊一声就能发射压缩空气。
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_MOMOTARO_DUMP: You have 3 dumplings. Right-click and choose an enemy to tame: only enemies with 10 or less current HP and 80 or less Max HP can be tamed, and bosses cannot. A tamed enemy is healed to full, its Max HP is lowered by 20%, it fights for you with its own moves and intents, cannot be healed, and disappears forever when it dies.
哆啦A梦的道具之一。喂给凶暴的怪兽吃下去，它就会变得像小狗一样温顺。
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_FOUR_DIMENSIO: When obtained, immediately grants a Doraemon gadget. The next 3 relics you would obtain from Elite combats are replaced by Doraemon gadgets.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_ANYWHERE_DOOR: Right-click to turn on free travel, letting you head straight to any unvisited node. Has 3 uses; right-click again to turn it off.
Right-click to turn on free travel, letting you head straight to any unvisited node.
哆啦A梦的道具之一。打开门，就能去往任何地方。

While free travel is on, every unvisited node on the map lights up as reachable; while it is off, nothing changes. Moving along map paths does not consume a use — only flying straight to a non-adjacent node costs 1. On the last remaining use, you cannot pick a route whose destination is a node you have already visited.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_BAMBOO_COPTER: At the start of combat, take off: you take 50% less damage from attacks. Expires after you are hit 5 times.
哆啦A梦的道具之一。戴在头上就能飞起来。
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_WHAT_IF_PHONE: Restart this combat on a new timeline.
哆啦A梦的道具之一。如果......
Changes your card draw order and more.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_TIME_CLOTH.de: Right-click to gain a [gold]Time Cloth[/gold] card. Only once per combat.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_TIME_CLOTH.fl: 哆啦A梦的道具之一。盖上去，时间就会前进或后退。
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_DAVES_SEEDS.d: Right-click this relic and pick one of three summon cards to bring a plant into the fight (paying that card's cost). Plants protect you from damage. Once per combat. After summoning, right-click again to gain a [gold]Fertilize[/gold] card.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_DAVES_SEEDS.s: {Cost} Energy, {Hp} HP. While in play, grants you {Energy} Energy at the start of each turn.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_DAVES_SEEDS.p: {Cost} Energy, {Hp} HP. While in play, deals {Damage} damage to the front enemy at the start of each turn.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_DAVES_SEEDS.w: {Cost} Energy, {Hp} HP. While in play, gains {Block} Block at the start of each turn.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_DAVES_SEEDS.f: {Cost} Energy. Your plants gain {Hp} Max HP and heal the same amount.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_OMNITRIX.desc: Right-click to transform into an alien hero for 3 turns. After transforming you gain that hero's abilities (their own deck and innate passive). Currently only 【Heatblast】's abilities are implemented; choosing another hero only swaps your appearance and grants no abilities.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_OMNITRIX.flav: 小小年纪所向无敌，神秘超能力，双手并用变身启动，实在好神奇，捍卫和平维护正义，叫他第一名 Ben 10。
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_FOUR_SOULS_GE: An ancient jewel said to grant its holder's wish. Upon being obtained it shatters into the [gold]Jewel of Four Souls Fragment[/gold], and every non-Boss enemy on the map gains a soul shard as well.
Four souls are sealed within: Wasteland, Harmony, Fortune and Wonder. Obtain the jewel, obtain the four souls.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_RELIC_FOUR_SOULS_FR: Right-click to toggle on or off (cannot be toggled in combat). While on, you gain power from the shards you hold and enemies holding soul shards appear on the map; defeating them lets you take their souls. Wasteland grants Strength, Harmony grants Plating, Fortune grants Regen, Wonder grants Max HP. The four corner badges show how many of each soul you hold.
A jewel split in four, each shard housing a different soul.
